verses.text: By David. LORD, take my side against those who come after me. Fight against those who fight me.
Grab your shield and buckler and stand up to help me.
Raise your spear and block the people chasing me. Tell my soul, “I'm the one who saves you.”
Let the people trying to take my life come away ashamed and dishonored. Turn back those plotting my ruin and leave them confused.
Make them like chaff in the wind, with the LORD's angel driving them away.
Let their path go dark and slippery, with the LORD's angel chasing them.
For no reason they hid a net for me in a pit. For no reason they dug a pit to take my life.
Let ruin catch him off guard. Let the net he hid catch him instead. Let him fall into his own trap.
My soul will celebrate in the LORD and take joy in how he saved me.
Every bone in my body will say, “LORD, who's like you? You rescue the poor from someone too strong for them, and the poor and needy from people who rob them.”
False witnesses stand up and question me about things I know nothing about.
I did good for them, and they paid me back with evil. It left my soul grieving.
When they were sick, I wore sackcloth. I humbled myself by fasting, and my prayer came back to my own heart.
I treated them as friends or brothers. I bowed down grieving like someone mourning their own mother.
But when I was in trouble, they celebrated and gathered against me. The attackers came together without me knowing. They tore into me and wouldn't stop.
Like people at a feast mocking what is sacred, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you watch this happen? Save me from the ruin they have planned. Rescue my precious life from the lions.
I'll thank you in the great gathering. I'll praise you in front of all those people.
Don't let people who are my enemies without cause celebrate over me. Don't let people who hate me for no reason wink at each other.
They don't speak peace. They make up lies about people who live quietly in the land.
They open their mouths wide against me and go, “Aha! Aha! We saw it ourselves!”
You've seen it, LORD. Don't stay silent. Lord, stay close to me.
Wake up! Get up and defend me, my God! My Lord, take up my case!
Show that I'm in the right, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don't let them gloat over me.
Don't let them think, “Yes! That's exactly what we wanted!” Don't let them say, “We swallowed him up!”
Let everyone who celebrates my trouble end up ashamed and confused. Let the people who talk big against me be dressed in shame and dishonor.
Let everyone who backs my just cause shout with joy. Let them keep saying, “Praise the greatness of the LORD, who delights in seeing his servant thrive!” 🙌
I'll talk about your righteousness and sing your praise all day long.
